sources.label: NAUR LesBin P1 (Role + Fixed Tether Utopia, Conga Fall of Faith)

steps.title: Cyclonic Break clock spots
steps.cue: Cyclonic Break cast, boss wreathed in fire or lightning
steps.rule: Take your clock spot around the boss: MT close in front (north), OT south, H1 west, H2 east, M1 south-west, M2 south-east, R1 north-west, R2 north-east. Every cone aims at its player, so keep apart.

steps.title: Dodge the repeat (spread or pairs)
steps.cue: First Cyclonic Break cones go off
steps.rule: The cones fire again where they first hit. Lightning: slide one cone-width clockwise and spread. Fire: meet your partner 8m out between your spots for Sinsmoke pairs: MT with R1, H2 with R2, OT with M2, H1 with M1.

steps.title: Back to your clock spot
steps.rule: Return to your original spot: the next set of cones turns one cone-width clockwise, onto the gap you just used.

steps.title: Slide clockwise again
steps.cue: Turned Cyclonic Break cones go off
steps.rule: Once the turned cones go off, slide one cone-width clockwise again; the last set turns one more width past you.

steps.title: Out of both Burnt Strikes
steps.cue: Turn of the Heavens and the west Burnt Strike cast
steps.rule: Run to the half where the halos don't match Turn of the Heavens' element (fire cast: the levin side), and stay north or south of the west Burnt Strike line on the half your clock spot was: MT, H1, R1, R2 north; OT, H2, M1, M2 south.

steps.title: Sinsmoke groups
steps.cue: Bound of Faith tethers and Prey on two players
steps.rule: Split into the two stack groups on the safe half: supports north, DPS south, so each group holds one Bound of Faith target. Both tethers on supports: the later of the two (MT, OT, H1, H2 order) swaps with M1. Both on DPS: the later of the two (M1, M2, R1, R2 order) swaps with MT.

steps.title: Hug the north line
steps.rule: Right after the north Burnt Strike line goes off, step in next to where it hit on the safe side, so Blastburn only pushes you a few metres into the safe half.

steps.title: Stack for Sinsmoke
steps.rule: Gather with your group near the middle of your quarter on the safe half and stack on the tethered player as the image charges.
